IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Ecology & Parks (originally sponsored by Representatives Dickerson, Hudgins, Lantz, and Schual-Berke)

Bill.BriefDescription: Reviewing the department of ecology's dredged material management program as it relates to polychlorinated biphenyls.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the management of hazardous wastes in PugetSound; creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of ecology shall, as partof its participation in the previously scheduled annual review of thedredged material management program, initiate a stakeholder discussionto review and consider changes to the existing dredge managementprogram as it relates to polychlorinated biphenyls. (2) The stakeholder discussion must include an initial review ofthe existing sampling and management protocol for polychlorinatedbiphenyls in dredge materials, including an examination of the currentchronic sublethal sediment bioassay and other protocols to determinethe chronic effects of contaminates on marine life, and develop a timeframe for updating the management protocol to reflect the most recentadvancements in technology and science. (3) The department of ecology shall present a summary of thediscussion, the anticipated next steps forward, and the identified timeframe to the appropriate committees of the legislature by September 1, p. 1 SHB 25532008. (4) This section expires July 30, 2009.
